lines: Due to the widespread Microsoft outage which has affected multiple applicants, the Los Angeles Housing Department has extended the Sponsor Application deadline to Monday, November 16, 2026 at 11:59pm Pacific Time.

Please click the button below to view the Homes For LA NOFA Round 2 transmittal. This transmittal contains the NOFA regulations and program term sheets as approved by Mayor Karen Bass and the Los Angeles City Council on September 24, 2026.

In three programs offered as part of Homes for LA, tenant governance is a requirement. This targeted session will provide your team with actionable frameworks, best practices, and compliance insights that help your projects effectively implement tenant governance models.
To access the recordings from Home for LA NOFA Round 2, please visit YouTube.com/@LAHD_Housing.

If you are watching the Tenant Governance Training #1 recording to receive credits towards the Tenant Governance experience requirement, please be sure to click here to take the mandatory quiz after watching the video.

If you are watching the Tenant Governance Training #2 recording to receive credits towards the Tenant Governance experience requirement, please be sure to click here to take the mandatory quiz after watching the video.

Your feedback on this training is appreciated. It helps The Hub improve their training and technical assistance offerings to better support applicants in developing and implementing meaningful tenant governance. You can find the feedback form here: Feedback Form

The term sheets contain the loan terms and unique requirements for each of the seven funding programs for which the Department will solicit applications. Within all seven programs, the Homes for LA NOFA Round 2 includes three programs focused on new construction of affordable housing, three programs focused on affordable housing preservation, and one program focused on stabilizing existing affordable housing through provision of operating assistance funds. Please thoroughly review the Homes For LA NOFA Round 2 Term Sheets if you intend to apply for competitive funding made available through this NOFA.
ULA Acquisition and Rehabilitation: Preserving Affordability

The Homes for LA NOFA Round 2 Regulations describe the standards, definitions, processes, and all other terms that are shared between the various funding programs. Additional requirements in the regulations include provisions outlined in the ULA measure and requirements from ULA Program Guidelines. Please thoroughly review the Homes For LA NOFA Round 2 Regulations if you intend to apply for competitive funding made available through this NOFA.

LAHD will begin holding Offices on October 19th, 2026. Please see below for information pertaining to Office Hours, including how to sign up.
Sponsor Underwriting Office Hours: Mondays from 2pm to 3pm, October 19th through November 2nd, 2026. Please sign up here.
ULA Operating Assistance Program and Portfolio Preservation Program Office Hours: Tuesdays from 1pm to 2pm, October 20th through November 24th, 2026. Please sign up here.
New Construction Programs Office Hours: Tuesdays from 2pm to 3pm, October 20th through November 24th, 2026. Please sign up here.
ULA Acq/Rehab Program and ULA Alt Models: Preservation Program Office Hours: Tuesdays from 3pm to 4pm, October 20th through November 24th, 2026. Please sign up here.

Each week LAHD staff review questions received through the multiple portals including the Homes For LA email address, the UNOFA portal and throughout the Office Hours. Those questions are answered, grouped by section and published in this section of the Homes For LA website. The Q&A are organized by the week in which the questions were obtained.
